summary: This Form 8-K under Item 8.01 is an unaudited net asset value (NAV) range estimate by Eagle Point Credit Co Inc.'s management for its common stock as of May 31, 2026. The filing contains no proposal, transaction, or catalyst; it is purely informational. No proxy contest, merger, tender offer, purchase, sale, restructuring, or management departure is involved. As a routine current report of an interim valuation metric, it falls outside special-situation categories and is classified as None.
